headline: Enhance ClearInstall for Local-first Security
summary: Integrate real-time threat intelligence to detect potential risks in local dependencies. Implement a user-friendly interface for easy binding.gyp command management and expand support for additional package managers like Go.
actions: Integrate API from Gathin23/cleanyourtv to scan for known vulnerabilities in npm packages before installation
Develop a feature allowing users to manage and review binding.gyp commands through a dedicated interface, reducing the risk of misconfiguration during local-fir
Expand ClearInstall’s compatibility to support Go package managers alongside npm and PyPI, ensuring comprehensive security checks across multiple ecosystems
